patterns.note: The site transitions between full-screen product showcases using a horizontal slide animation, where the next colored slide pushes the current one out of frame, accompanied by a slide counter indicator.
Interior pages utilize an asymmetrical, highly editorial layout with labels and section titles pinned to the far left, leaving massive white space before the content columns on the right.
A strict monochromatic base of deep greys and silvers is punctuated by single-color full-bleed slides (like moss green) and warm, fiery imagery to create dramatic visual shifts.
Large, clean, geometric sans-serif headings are paired with delicate outlined typography in the intro pattern, emphasizing precision and craftsmanship.

technique_notes: To recreate the horizontal transition effect, use locomotive-scroll to hijack vertical scroll and translate it into horizontal slide movements for the product showcase sections, complete with a progress indicator tracking slide numbers.
For the intro screen, implement a Lottie animation that draws or highlights the intricate geometric line-art pattern before fading into the main product hero section.

Recreate the product hero spotlight by applying a radial gradient overlay on a dark background, positioned directly behind a high-resolution, angled product render to simulate a dramatic studio lighting setup.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, clean sans-serif headings (~4x body size) with generous letter-spacing, contrasted against small, highly readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Pill-shaped for interactive elements like the contact button, while all structural sections and image containers maintain sharp, precise corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Extremely airy and editorial, featuring massive negative space on informational pages and full-bleed immersive layouts for product slides.

standout: The site's standout feature is its transition from an intricate, abstract geometric line-art intro into a dramatic, horizontally-scrolling product showcase that feels like a high-end physical gallery.
